### Daily Disciples - June 9, 2011 (The Arm of Flesh)
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-june-9-2011.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 32:7-8
Points:
- Even faithful leaders who honor God can face sudden, intimidating attacks from powerful adversaries.
- Hezekiah took practical defensive actions and made weapons rather than surrendering to fear.
- Human might and worldly power are limited to an arm of flesh.
- Lasting courage comes from knowing the Lord is present and fights our battles.
- The greatest weapon in trial is a tender heart that turns to God in earnest prayer.
